title: Craft Development Closure Migration Plan

predecessor.reason: The development inventory proved that baseline closure and copied-ledger reference closure must precede active-name rebinding.

objective: Restore dependency closure for the copied Craft workspace by preserving the old development baseline bridge, producing a tested successor current-baseline candidate, resolving every copied-ledger development reference, and migrating only frozen active bundles before name rebinding resumes.
construction_rule: Preserve first, distinguish historical from current, validate each dependency-closed layer, and continue automatically through passing internal gates until the configured final product boundary. Internal gates verify evidence but do not request approval or grant authority.

included: the exact historical baseline control and frozen-evidence bridge
one successor current-baseline candidate with deterministic projections
owner-frozen EVF and EVF reference-consumer source bundles
final active-name/path rebinding and integrated product testing
excluded: bulk copying all 9,190 tracked development files
all ignored dependencies, caches, and generated build residue
admission, activation, consumer cutover, publication, release, deployment, or source deletion

plan_capability.reason: The plan is complete as a Lab planning candidate, but the selected architecture is not an admitted Invoke Design v3 bundle and CyberAlchemy-v2 Goals registration is currently blocked.
plan_capability.repair_route: After owner review, use CA2-ROUTE-IMPLEMENT with the exact L0 allowlist and a fresh source preflight; do not represent this package as an admitted Invoke Plan.

baseline_bridge.copy_policy: additive, byte-identical, mode-preserving, collision-refusing, exact allowlist only
baseline_bridge.rollback: Remove only destinations named by the bridge manifest when their hashes still equal the copied hashes; preserve all pre-existing Craft bytes.

rounds.proposer_claim: Migrate all three T0 development directories as the closure unit.
rounds.evidence_or_assumption: The inventory classifies backend-meta-type-conformance, implementation-conformance, and meta-type-instantiation-cli as T0.
rounds.balancer_objection: Directory copying would mix required bridge records with hundreds of unrelated historical and experimental files.

rounds.proposer_claim: Copy only the six baseline control records and five missing frozen inventory members.
rounds.evidence_or_assumption: These eleven files are the minimum explicit source closure needed to preserve and inspect baseline v2 locally.
rounds.balancer_objection: Twenty-four current source members differ from baseline v2, so the copied bridge cannot be labeled current.

distill.recomposition_proof: The eleven-file bridge preserves the prior baseline manifest, decision, validator, derived views, and every development-resident frozen member. It enables the next layer to compare old admitted hashes with current bytes without importing unrelated development history.
distill.evolution_profile: Later layers add current-baseline semantics, reference closure, active bundles, and integration without enlarging L0.
distill.deferred_complexity: Bulk history migration, name rebinding, runtime installation, admission, publication, and deletion are outside L0.
distill.premortem: Likely failure: baseline v2 is accidentally presented as current. Guardrail: historical-only classification is a required gate predicate and the 24 drift members remain explicit.
distill.frame_expiry: Re-run Distill if the baseline inventory, its 24-member drift set, or the eleven selected source hashes change.

layers.name: Historical baseline bridge
layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether baseline v2 can be preserved locally with exact provenance without importing unrelated development history or claiming it is current.
layers.minimum_working_unit: Copy the exact eleven-file allowlist and generate a copy manifest plus independent validation receipt.
layers.operator_visible_outcome: Craft contains a complete inspectable historical baseline bridge.
layers.risk_reduced: Loss of provenance and accidental bulk import.
layers.promotion_decision: Continue automatically to L1 only when every exit check passes; otherwise stop and repair.

layers.name: Successor current-baseline candidate
layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether the current 771-member implementation can be represented and reproduced as a successor candidate without rewriting baseline v2.
layers.minimum_working_unit: Disposition all 24 drifted members, materialize one new candidate manifest and projections, and replay validators twice.
layers.operator_visible_outcome: One deterministic current candidate exists alongside immutable baseline v2.
layers.risk_reduced: Treating current source drift as either silent acceptance or unexplained corruption.
layers.promotion_decision: Continue automatically to L2 on PASS; admission remains deferred to its owner.

layers.name: Copied-ledger development reference closure
layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether every copied ledger reference has an explicit local, external, or retired disposition without broken implicit paths.
layers.minimum_working_unit: Classify and validate all 126 development artifact references against a closed disposition registry.
layers.operator_visible_outcome: The Craft ledger no longer relies on accidental path availability.
layers.risk_reduced: Silent broken references and evidence/authority collapse.
layers.promotion_decision: Continue automatically to any dependency-ready L3 bundle; unresolved references stop only their dependent bundle.
non_regression: no directory implies a Bounded Context

layers.name: Frozen active development bundles
layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether selected active product/evidence bundles can move without importing live writer changes or generated residue.
layers.minimum_working_unit: Migrate one owner-frozen dependency-closed bundle at a time from the L2 registry, starting with EVF only after a stable source epoch exists.
layers.operator_visible_outcome: Selected active work has one inspectable candidate home in Craft.
layers.risk_reduced: Freezing an active writer accidentally or migrating local build state.
layers.promotion_decision: Continue per independent bundle; a blocked bundle does not hide other runnable product work.
non_regression: active source is never silently canonicalized

layers.name: Rebound and integrated Craft candidate
layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether one exact Craft candidate works from final names and paths with complete current product-test evidence.
layers.minimum_working_unit: Rebind only active selected surfaces, run all required toolchain and hostile checks, freeze one candidate, and present the single final product boundary.
layers.operator_visible_outcome: One immutable tested Craft candidate is ready for the configured final product decision.
layers.risk_reduced: Approving partial or stale migration evidence.
layers.promotion_decision: Stop at the single final product-approval boundary.

swus.primary_behavior: Copy exactly eleven immutable historical baseline inputs and prove byte, path, classification, and rollback closure.
swus.split_analysis: Splitting control records from their five frozen development members loses baseline closure; adding any other directory member introduces unrelated history.
swus.acceptance_boundary: 11/11 exact copies, zero other craft changes, historical-only status, deterministic receipt, reversible manifest.

swus.primary_behavior: Create one deterministic candidate baseline from current bytes while preserving baseline v2 unchanged.
swus.split_analysis: A manifest without all drift dispositions hides semantics; admission remains separately splittable and is excluded.
swus.acceptance_boundary: 771/771 closure, 24/24 dispositions, two-run determinism, old baseline unchanged, no admission claim.

swus.primary_behavior: Give every copied-ledger development reference one explicit disposition.
swus.split_analysis: The 126-row denominator must remain atomic to prove absence of accidental unresolved references.
swus.acceptance_boundary: 126/126 exactly-once classifications and zero implicit paths.

swus.primary_behavior: Copy one owner-frozen dependency-closed active bundle without generated residue.
swus.split_analysis: One bundle is independently verifiable; combining bundles would couple unrelated owners and rollback scopes.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Stable source epoch, exact allowlist, no ignored/generated files, bundle tests and rollback PASS.

swus.primary_behavior: Rebind selected active surfaces and freeze one completely tested Craft candidate.
swus.split_analysis: Rebinding may be executed in internal dependency slices, but product candidacy requires their exact integrated closure and complete tests.
swus.acceptance_boundary: One immutable candidate, complete PASS evidence, and one final product decision boundary.

ordered_rules: Re-open the canonical development inventory and verify its digest.
Re-hash every source allowlist entry and require the recorded digest and byte size.
Require every destination to be absent or already byte-identical; reject differing collisions.
Copy through a staging directory and rename each file only after verification.
Write a machine manifest that labels baseline v2 historical-only and preserves the 24-member drift denominator.
Run the independent validator twice and require byte-identical receipts.
implementation_details.rollback_rule: Remove only manifest-created destinations whose current hash still equals the copied hash; otherwise stop for owner review.

ordered_rules: Bind an exact Node profile.
Classify all 24 changed members without inference.
Generate one absent successor candidate.
Replay materialization and hostile stale-hash tests twice.
Keep admission status false.
implementation_details.rollback_rule: Delete only the absent candidate epoch; baseline v2 remains untouched.

ordered_rules: Freeze the 126-reference denominator.
Assign local, external, or retired exactly once.
Bind owners and locators.
Reject inferred context membership.
Run unresolved-reference mutants.
implementation_details.rollback_rule: Restore the previous copied ledger and remove only the candidate reference registry.

ordered_rules: Require owner-frozen source epoch.
Select one dependency-closed bundle.
Exclude ignored and generated residue.
Copy exact files.
Run bundle tests and rollback rehearsal.
implementation_details.rollback_rule: Rollback only that bundle's manifest-created files.

ordered_rules: Apply dependency-ordered active-name rebinding.
Regenerate human projections from canonical machine sources.
Bind explicit Lab planes and contexts.
Run complete current tests.
Freeze candidate and stop at final product boundary.
implementation_details.rollback_rule: Apply the exact inverse rebinding map and preserve all historical migration evidence.

gates.failure_route: stop and repair L1; no approval request

gates.failure_route: block only dependent bundles and repair unresolved references

runnable_product_work: Re-hash and copy the exact eleven-file historical bridge after an explicit implementation-route instruction.

Freeze EVF and EVF reference-consumer source epochs

closeout_obligations: Every layer binds an immutable machine manifest and independently generated validation receipt.
Changed acceptance-bound bytes create a new candidate epoch; receipts are never refreshed over changed bytes.
Historical baseline v2 remains inspectable and unchanged.
The single final product decision binds the exact L4 candidate and complete current tests.
Operational authority remains a later separate route even after product approval.
claim_ceiling: This plan selects and sequences candidate migration work. It does not copy development files, resolve the 24 semantic dispositions, admit a successor baseline, rewrite the ledger, freeze active writers, approve the product, activate consumers, publish, release, deploy, or delete source material.
